uncited: Builds on the geometric definition of rays and the parallel execution model from [Ray generation and camera models](770-ray-generation-and-camera-models.md).

**Definition**: A coordinate transformation that maps 3D points to $(\alpha, \beta, \gamma)$ where $\alpha$ specifies the epipolar slice, $\beta$ is the angle of the view ray relative to the light direction, and $\gamma$ is the distance from the light ray through the eye point.
**Pitfall**: At the epipole (where view rays and light rays are parallel), the rectification mapping is singular and the derivative $ds/d\gamma$ goes to infinity.
